title: S68 — Census: the easy residue — the 25 easy misses by root cause (S43 method)
desc: NEW-OP STARTER. GOAL: apply the S43 census method to the EASY suite: each of the ~25 easy misses of the current shipping reader gets a root-cause row (segmentation / case / glyph / other) with counts and examples. WHY: easy is the closest bar (75/100 → target 98) and its residue has never been censused item-by-item the way hard was. READ FIRST: reports/s43_failure_analysis.md (definitions), the current easy receipt reports/s55-bench-seed1-3x. STEPS: regenerate seed-1 easy; recompute the reader's per-item reads; classify per definitions; publish. EVIDENCE: reports/census-easy/<date>.md + json + PUSHES row + formalcode line. BOUNDARIES: census only; same proxy definitions as S43; no fixes. Boundaries: no edits to shipping paths unless the task says so; no tuning on canonical seeds 1/2/3/4/53 (evaluation only); honest numbers — no 98/95 claims; captchaproject(s) off-limits.
